china_stack.title: The Chinese context-management stack
china_stack.takeaway: China's labs solved long context as an economics problem — attention compression (MLA→DSA→CSA/HCA), hybrid linear architectures, KV-cache-centric serving (Mooncake, now inside vLLM/SGLang), and a VC-funded memory-OS layer (MemOS) — and by shipping the weights MIT/Apache made their stack the substrate of global context research, even though K3's own paper concedes open weights still trail Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol.
china_stack.notes: All load-bearing numbers verified against primary pages via 12 WebFetch calls (cap): MLA -93.3% KV / 5.76x (arXiv 2405.04434); DSA + 50%+ price cut Sep 29 2025 (api-docs.deepseek.com); V4-Pro 1.6T/49B, 27% FLOPs / 10% KV vs V3.2 at 1M ctx (arXiv 2606.19348); Qwen3-Next 80B/3B, 262,144 native / ~1,010,000 YaRN, 12x(3 DeltaNet + 1 Gated Attention) (HF card); MemOS 11.0k stars / LoCoMo 88.83 / LongMemEval 89.20 / 35.24% token savings, DeepSeek Harness plugin Aug 17 2026 (GitHub — note: sweep said 1.1k forks, fetch shows 1.0k; used fetched); K3 2.8T/104B, 16-of-896 experts, ~2.5x vs K2, trails Fable 5/GPT-5.6 Sol (arXiv 2607.24653); MiniMax-01 456B/45.9B, 1M train / 4M inference (arXiv 2501.08313); Mooncake 6.4k stars, FAST 2025 Best Paper, +75% requests, vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT-LLM/LMDeploy/LMCache/NIXL, NVIDIA/AMD/Huawei/AWS/Cambricon/Moore Threads (GitHub); Qwen2.5-1M 3-7x prefill speedup (arXiv 2501.15383); MemOS MemCube unifies plaintext/activation/parameter memory (arXiv 2507.03724); GLM-4.5 355B/32B, 23T tokens + 106B Air (arXiv 2508.06471); MoBA deployed for Kimi, open code (arXiv 2502.13189). Headline-only (marked in fragment): V4 day-0 Ascend (InfoQ 2026-04-24), Qwen3.8-Max (CRN 2026-08-07), GLM-5.2 1M/#1 Code Arena (CSDN 2026-06-18), MiniMax M3 1M + 15.6x tease (Decoder/VentureBeat), Hunyuan Hy3 open-source (新浪财经 2026-04-23), MemTensor ~RMB100M Pre-A w/ Huawei/Honor/SenseTime (新浪财经/品玩 Jul 2026), Hao Jianye 3 rounds/6 months (36氪 2026-08-11, sizes unknown), MemoraX $10M+ seed / 数亿元 cumulative (投资界/智东西), 01.AI wind-down (新浪财经 2026-08-10), V4-Pro price to 1/4 (Caixin 2026-05-25). Discrepancy flagged: InfoQ headline says V4 open-weights Apr 24 2026 vs Wikipedia's V4-Flash Jul 31 / V4-Pro Aug 13 2026 production launches — fragment uses paper date + MIT license and avoids the contested launch dates. Zero search-helper calls needed; sweep evidence was sufficient.

china_market.takeaway: China's memory/context layer is a real funded category — MemTensor's ~¥100M CVC-backed Pre-A leads four memory startups — but it is being commoditized in real time (platforms give memory away free, 1M-token open models cut API prices to a quarter of list) while state capital, xinchuang/dual-filing rules, and the Manus block wall the market off from US entrants in both directions: expect commoditization pressure via Chinese open source in your own stack, not head-to-head competition in China.
